description: Instruction data and account metas from the SPL Token (p-token) conformance fuzz fixtures. Token-2022 shares the base instruction set and discriminators 0-24; the fixtures were executed against SPL Token, so spl_token_program_result is SPL Token's result, not Token-2022's.
extraction: data = input.data; accounts = input.instr_accounts (index into the fixture's account list, signer and writable flags); duplicates of (data, accounts) dropped
